senses.ex: My uncle tells really funny stories.
senses.exPt: Meu tio conta histórias muito engraçadas.

senses.def: strange or unusual
senses.ex: There's a funny smell in the car.
senses.exPt: Tem um cheiro estranho no carro.

senses.def: the thick soft hair on the body of some animals
senses.ex: Our cat has very soft white fur.
senses.exPt: Nossa gata tem o pelo branco e muito macio.

senses.def: animal skin with its hair, used to make clothes
senses.ex: She refuses to wear a fur coat.
senses.exPt: Ela se recusa a usar casaco de pele.

senses.def: to put furniture in a room or house
senses.ex: We rented a flat that was already furnished.
senses.exPt: Alugamos um apartamento que já estava mobiliado.

senses.def: things like chairs, tables and beds in a room
senses.ex: We bought new furniture for the living room.
senses.exPt: Compramos móveis novos para a sala.

senses.def: more, or extra
senses.ex: For further information, please call this number.
senses.exPt: Para mais informações, ligue para este número.

senses.def: used to add more information
senses.ex: The hotel was expensive; furthermore, the rooms were dirty.
senses.exPt: O hotel era caro; além disso, os quartos estavam sujos.

senses.def: at or to the greatest distance
senses.ex: Let's see who can throw the ball furthest.
senses.exPt: Vamos ver quem consegue jogar a bola mais longe.

senses.def: unnecessary worry, excitement or complaining about something small
senses.ex: Don't make such a fuss about a small scratch.
senses.exPt: Não faça tanto escândalo por causa de um arranhão pequeno.

senses.def: the time that will come after now
senses.ex: In the future, I want to live abroad.
senses.exPt: No futuro, eu quero morar no exterior.
